arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected originating from IP 10.0.5.14, later traced to compromised internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) associated with user jsmith@corp.local. The host exhibited C2 beaconing to 198.51.100.23 via Cobalt Strike, followed by lateral movement attempts. Initial alert misattributed source due to NAT or proxy; actual compromised asset identified through SIEM correlation and IOC lookup. Firewall block on 10.0.5.14 failed verification, indicating possible misconfiguration or incomplete enforcement.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        maltype = "backdoor"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 8B ?? 0C 8B ?? 04 8B ?? 24 8B ?? 05 } 
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0;" wide ascii
        $c = "x86" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
